proposals: The Ministry of Jal Shakti should publish the all-India summary volume of the 7th Minor Irrigation Census, with a table comparing each headline figure against the 6th census, so that the ownership and groundwater shares here, still dated to 2017–18, can be updated from an official national total.

The Ministry of Jal Shakti should report, in future Minor Irrigation Census volumes, area irrigated and the number of distinct owners alongside the count of schemes, so that the private share of India's irrigation can be stated in hectares and farmers, not only in schemes.

The Ministry of Jal Shakti should publish the financing breakdown for schemes with mixed sources of finance, not only the 60.2 per cent with a single source, so that the 79.5 per cent own-savings figure can be extended to the whole census rather than one subset of it.

The Department of Water Resources should publish an annual state-wise series of public capital spending on irrigation set against irrigation potential created, potential utilised and net irrigated area, so that the finding that public investment has barely tracked results can be checked from open official data rather than a paywalled paper.

State electricity regulatory commissions should publish the annual agricultural power subsidy per pump set, split between metered and unmetered connections, so that the running cost of privately built groundwater irrigation can be set beside the census's ownership and financing figures.
